sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Man with short brown side-parted swept-back wavy hair, dark hairy brows, a thin neat dark moustache above upper lip and bare jaw/chin. No glasses or hat. Serious small mouth holds a genuine curved dark smoking pipe toward screen left: slim black/brown bent stem, a distinct small upturned brown bowl with pale rim and smoke rising from the bowl. Gray/slate blue sleeveless V-neck sweater vest over pale shirt and burgundy tie. Preserve original moustache size, exact bent pipe/bowl instead of a straight cigar, pose/gaze slightly upward-left, close bust/crop/upper-left lighting and full charcoal-gray painted rectangle. Tiny pipe markings, individual moustache hairs and knit weave are unresolved. Use one mouth and remove human nose/ears.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Man with voluminous dark swept-back quiff and close brown side hair, dark brows, short brown/dark stubble beard along cheeks/jaw/chin and a small moustache. No glasses or hat, serious downturned closed lips. A narrow near-vertical scar above screen-right brow and a separate oblique/branching screen-right cheek scar group are visible; preserve groups and placement without inventing fine branches. Brown trench coat has broad layered lapels and screen-right shoulder strap over black inner high-neck shirt. Preserve hair volume, facial hair, source screen-left three-quarter pose/crop/light and full charcoal-gray painted backing. Keep compact mascot head/short broad neck and one mouth, removing human nose/ears. Tiny scar edges, beard strands and seam relief are unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Man with tan/brown fedora and wide black band, short dark brown side hair, dark brows and a full dark jaw/chin beard with moustache. No glasses, serious small closed mouth, eyes/head raised toward screen left. Brown broad-lapel suit over pale cream pointed-collar buttoned shirt without tie, pale triangular pocket square at screen right. Preserve original hat tilt/band, actual beard and side-hair groups, clothes/pocket square, close bust/light/crop and complete dark gray painted rectangle. Individual beard hairs, button relief and hat weave are unresolved, not invented writing. Replace the human face/ears with smooth compact mascot anatomy and a short broad collar transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Man with short brown hair swept upward/back, dark brows, prominent curled handlebar moustache plus a real short full jaw/chin beard and visible dark stubble below jaw; do not make this variant clean-shaven. Serious slightly raised head toward screen left, mouth holds a slender brown smoking roll projecting screen left with smoke rising from its distal tip. Russet/brown suit jacket over pale cream pointed shirt and dark olive/black tie. Preserve actual moustache curls/beard length, source prop/mouth, pose/bust crop/light and complete charcoal-gray painted rectangle. Fine faint cheek marks are too small to identify precise scar microstructure; do not invent extra marks or text. Convert human nose/ears and long throat into compact rounded mascot face/short broad fitted collar.
